annotations.title: Founders only: create a draft of your own startup pitch on PitchSpark

description: For founders raising a pre-seed or seed round: create a draft pitch on your own PitchSpark account from five facts (company name, sector, stage, raise amount in USD, a one-paragraph problem statement). The draft is not listed, searchable or scored until the founder completes it and submits it for review in Pitch Studio at the returned edit_url. Needs a founder submit token (pss_..., from PitchSpark Settings). Where OAuth is enabled, a token with the pitches:submit scope also works. Returns pitch_id, status "draft", company_name and edit_url.

company_name.description: The startup's name, one line, e.g. "Acme Robotics".

problem_statement.description: One paragraph (40 to 1200 characters) on the problem and who has it. Its first sentence becomes the tagline.

raise_amount_usd.description: Amount being raised in US dollars, e.g. 1500000.

sector.description: Primary sector, e.g. "fintech". Keys: fintech, healthtech, saas, marketplace, ai_ml, consumer, enterprise, climate, edtech, crypto, biotech, hardware, gaming, real_estate, food_beverage, fashion, travel, sports, media, femtech, cybersecurity, dev_tools, ecommerce, logistics, mobility, hr_tech, legal_tech, insurtech, proptech, agtech, energy, robotics, govtech, hospitality, other.

stage.description: Stage of the round being raised, e.g. "seed".

name: pitchspark_submit_pitch_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.
